name: ludo
description: Real-time multiplayer Ludo game (React Native + Supabase). The game engine is the source of truth; everything else is a projection of state.

scripts.test: npm test --workspace packages/engine && npm test --workspace packages/bot && npm test --workspace mobile
scripts.typecheck:edge: npm run build:edge && npx --yes deno@2.1.4 check supabase/functions/game/index.ts supabase/functions/ads-ssv/index.ts supabase/functions/rc-webhook/index.ts
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:engine && npm run build:bot
